controles.affirmation: En fevrier 2026, le procureur de Milan a place les operations italiennes sous administration judiciaire provisoire, le temps d'une enquete sur les pratiques de remuneration des livreurs Deliveroo
controles.verbatim_source: For example, in February 2026, the Milan Public Prosecutor placed our operations in Italy under temporary judicial administration pending an investigation into Deliveroo's rider pay practices. While we are cooperating fully with the Milan Public Prosecutor and believe our current pay model meets local requirements, we cannot predict the outcome of this or other similar actions... (10-Q T2 2026, Item 1A)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance omise : la societe ajoute 'we believe our current pay model meets local requirements'.

controles.affirmation: L'administration fiscale de Californie (CA EDD) a emis en janvier 2023 un redressement lie au statut d'independant, et la societe a inscrit une provision au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: the Company is currently under audit by the Employment Development Department, State of California (the 'CA EDD') for payroll tax liabilities. In January 2023, the CA EDD issued an assessment for certain amounts that it found to be owed by the Company on behalf of Dashers due to their being classified as independent contractors... the Company has recorded an accrual for this matter within accrued expenses and other current liabilities on the condensed consolidated balance sheets as of June 30, 2026. (10-Q T2 2026, note engagements)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance omise : 'The Company believes that Dashers are, and have been, properly classified as independent contractors... believes that it has meritorious defenses and intends to vigorously appeal.' Le montant de la provision n'est pas publie.

controles.affirmation: La directive europeenne sur le travail de plateforme, entree en vigueur en decembre 2024, oblige chaque Etat membre a legiferer sur la requalification
controles.verbatim_source: the EU's Platform Work Directive, which entered into force in December 2024, requires EU member states to transpose its requirements to their national laws, including enacting new national laws for determining worker classification of platform workers (10-Q T2 2026, Item 1A)

controles.affirmation: Les frais juridiques, fiscaux et reglementaires exclus des mesures ajustees sont passes de 58 a 143 M$ (+147%). 'Une charge qui triple n'est plus exceptionnelle.'
controles.verbatim_source: Certain legal, tax, and regulatory settlements, reserves, and expenses (1) 29 98 58 143 (10-Q T2 2026, rapprochement Adjusted EBITDA)
controles.correction_proposee: Les chiffres sont exacts mais 58 -> 143 est une multiplication par 2,5, pas par 3. Le mot 'triple' contredit le '+147%' ecrit deux lignes plus haut. Ecrire : 'une charge qui a plus que double'. Preciser aussi que la ligne recouvre des reglements et provisions ('settlements, reserves'), pas seulement des frais.
